Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is an invigorating pranayama that involves active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation [PROG_P_002]. Sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath in, and exhale in short, powerful bursts while your stomach pumps inwards [PROG_P_002].

It stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, strengthens the legs and core, helps with stress, and improves digestion [PROG_Y_003]. Hold for 30-60 seconds, but avoid it if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury, and make sure not to lock your knees [PROG_Y_003].

Surya Namaskar is a sequence of 12 powerful yoga asanas performed in coordination with your breath. It is best done early morning on an empty stomach. A complete round consists of two sets, starting with the right leg and then the left. Regular practice provides great cardiovascular benefits, helps with weight loss (वजन घटाना), strengthens muscles and joints, and improves digestion while reducing stress (*tanav*) [DOC_001]. If you have any health concerns, particularly high blood pressure or back problems, please consult a certified instructor or doctor before beginning.

Anulom Vilom Pranayama ke fayde yeh hain: yeh man ko shant karne aur stress door karne mein madad karta hai. Isse Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) ka santulan bhi banta hai. Yeh concentration aur patience ko behtar karta hai. Iska sahi samay subah (morning) hota hai, khaas taur par nashta karne se pehle. Par dhyan rakhein ki agar aapko sardi, khansi, ya bukhar ho, toh isse na karein [DOC_001].

Aapke liye ek balanced Indian diet chart yeh hai: 

- Breakfast mein poha, upma ya idli le sakte hain, fried foods se bachna chahiye.
- Lunch mein 2 rotis, dal, sabzi, aur salad ka ek bowl hona chahiye.
- Dinner sabse halka meal hona chahiye; khichdi ya dal ke saath vegetable stir-fry achha hai. 
- Seasonal fruits aur vegetables zaroor shamil karein, aur rozana 8-10 glasses paani piyein. Processed sugar aur excessive salt se door rahein. 

Non-vegetarians grilled chicken ya fish ko fried options par tarjeeh dein [DOC_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is a rejuvenating pranayama that purifies the body. It involves active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation. To practice, sit comfortably with a straight spine, inhale deeply, and exhale in short, powerful bursts, pumping your stomach inwards. Start with 20-30 pumps and you can do up to 3 rounds with breaks in between. It's beneficial for stimulating the digestive system and boosting metabolic rate, which may aid in weight loss. Avoid if pregnant or have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy, and perform on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning. [DOC_002]

Trikonasana, or Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing pose that stretches the entire body. To perform it, stand with your feet wide apart, turn your right foot out 90 degrees, and your left foot in slightly. Inhale, then exhale while extending your torso to the right, placing your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor, and extending your left arm up. This pose benefits the hamstrings, hips, and spine, strengthens the legs and core, and helps with stress relief and digestion. Avoid it if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury. Hold for 30-60 seconds [DOC_003].

Low blood pressure ya respiratory issues (jaise asthma) wale logon ke liye yeh sahi nahi hai. [DOC_004]

Nashta mein poha, upma, ya idli chunein fried foods ki jagah. Dopahar ke bhojan mein 2 rotis, ek katori dal, sabzi, aur salad ka ek bhaag le. Raat ka khana sabse halka hona chahiye; khichdi ya dal ke saath vegetable stir-fry ek achha vikalp hai. Mausami phal aur sabziyaan shamil karein. Din mein kam se kam 8-10 glass paani pine ka dhyan dein. Processed sugar aur adhik namak se bachein. Non-vegetarians grilled chicken ya fish ko tarjeeh dein fried preparations ki jagah. Nuts aur seeds par snacking cravings manage karne ka ek accha tareeka hai [PROG_D_001].

Kapalbhati, or Skull Shining Breath, is a pranayama technique that helps cleanse the body. It involves active, forceful exhalation and passive inhalation. To practice, sit comfortably with a straight spine, take a deep breath, and then exhale in short, powerful bursts. Your stomach should pump inward with each exhalation. Start with a round of 20-30 pumps, and you can do up to 3 rounds with breaks in between. This practice can stimulate the digestive system and improve metabolic rate, which aids in weight loss. Avoid Kapalbhati if you are pregnant, have high blood pressure, heart disease, hernia, or epilepsy. It's best to perform it on an empty stomach, preferably in the morning [PROG_P_002].

Trikonasana, also known as Triangle Pose, is a foundational standing yoga pose that involves stretching the entire body. To perform it, stand with your feet wide apart. Turn your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in slightly. As you inhale, extend your torso to the right, bending from the hips and placing your right hand on your shin, ankle, or the floor. Raise your left arm towards the sky. This pose stretches the hamstrings, hips, and spine, strengthens the legs and core, and can be therapeutic for stress and digestion. Avoid this pose if you have a headache, low blood pressure, or a neck injury, and do not lock your knees. Hold for 30-60 seconds [PROG_Y_003].

Garmi ke liye, Sheetali Pranayama (Cooling Breath) ek accha vikalp ho sakta hai. Ye pranayama shareer aur man ko thanda karne mein madad karta hai. Iske liye, aapko aaram se baithna hoga. Apni jeebh ko gol shape mein roll karke bahar nikal kar, dheere-dheere us tube se saans andar le, jaise ek straw se hawa sip kar rahe ho. Fir, jeebh ko andar le kar, moonh bandh karke, naakt ke madhyam se saans bahar chhod den. Is prakriya ko 5-10 baar dohraen. Ye sharir ko cool karta hai aur bhukh aur pyaas ko niyantrit karne mein madadgar hai. [PROG_P_004]

Immunity badhane ke liye apne diet mein kuch khaas cheezein shamil karen. Amla, oranges, aur lemons jaise citrus fruits apki rog pratirodhak chhamata ko majboot banate hain kyunki inmein Vitamin C hota hai. Haldi mein curcumin hota hai jo ek powerful anti-inflammatory compound hai, ise doodh ya curries mein shamil karen. Adrak aur lahsun apne medicinal properties ke liye mashhoor hain. Dahi ek accha probiotic source hai jo gut health ke liye achha hota hai. Hari sabziyan jaise palak antioxidants se bhari hoti hain. Badam Vitamin E ka accha source hai. Hamesha balanced diet rakhnah chahiye [PROG_D_002].

Yogi Devvrat is a certified RYT 500 Yoga Alliance instructor with over 15 years of experience. He started his yoga journey in Rishikesh, learning from traditional yoga gurus. His teaching style combines classical Hatha yoga with modern Vinyasa flow, focusing on alignment and breath. Yogi Devvrat is known for including pranayama and meditation in his sessions and specializes in therapeutic yoga, helping clients manage chronic pain and stress-related ailments [PROG_I_001].

Millets are ancient grains known for their remarkable health benefits. They are gluten-free and contain high levels of fiber, protein, and antioxidants. For instance, Ragi (Finger Millet) is a great source of calcium, which supports bone health. Jowar (Sorghum) is rich in iron and protein, and Bajra (Pearl Millet) contains magnesium, promoting heart health. Millets help with weight management by keeping you feeling full for longer and have a low glycemic index, making them suitable for diabetics. You can integrate them into your meals by using them as a substitute for rice or making rotis from their flour [PROG_D_004].

Shavasana (Corpse Pose) is excellent for deep relaxation. You lie flat on your back with feet comfortably apart and arms by your side, palms facing up. Close your eyes, letting go of breath control, and bring awareness to each body part, releasing tension (*thakaan*). This helps reduce blood pressure, calm the nervous system, and combat insomnia. Stay in Shavasana for 5-10 minutes, focusing on relaxation without falling asleep [PROG_Y_004]. Alternatively, you can try Balasana (Child's Pose) by kneeling, sitting back on your heels, and folding forward with your forehead on the floor. This pose stretches the hips, thighs, and ankles while alleviating stress and fatigue [PROG_Y_005].

Dia Malik is a certified clinical nutritionist with a Master's degree in Food and Nutrition. She has assisted over 500 clients in achieving their health goals, including weight management and managing conditions like PCOS and diabetes, through dietary adjustments. Dia's approach focuses on a no-deprivation philosophy, emphasizing that healthy food can also be delicious. She creates sustainable diet plans that fit clients' lifestyles and cultural eating habits, particularly specializing in Indian cuisine. If you're interested in a personalized meal plan, you can book a one-on-one consultation with Dia Malik, available on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4 PM to 6 PM [PROG_I_002].

Staying hydrated is vital for overall health. Paani ka upyog aapke sharir ke taapmaan ko niyantrit karta hai, jo joints ko lubrikate karta hai aur cells tak poshak tatvon ki pahunch ko sunishchit karta hai. Paani ki kami se sir dard, thakan, aur dhyaan sankalan me kami ho sakti hai. Din me 8-10 glass paani peena chahiye, aur agar aap vyaayam karte hain ya din garmi ka hai to aur zyada. Khanas se pehle paani peene se wajan niyantran me madad mil sakti hai, kyunki yeh bhookh kam karne me sahayak hota hai. Yeh kidney function ke liye anivarya hai aur sharir se vishalee padarthon ko door karta hai [PROG_D_003].
